label: TheWaypoints
releaseNotes: 0.99 Beta 5: Fixes extension service startup by using a valid dot-free Karoo extension ID. Prior IDs could prevent all fields from starting and show No Sensor. Remove and re-add POI fields and rebind Open POIs after upgrading; app data is retained. Preserves initial custom tile status updates. Nearest downloaded and last-selected modes remain; compact taps are still experimental. No dependency change or data migration. Based on the original Waypoints idea and codebase by Vadim Sinitskiy.
